newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's MEFF futures volume up 26.22 pct in Jan.
newsitem.headline: Spain's MEFF futures volume up 26.22 pct in Jan.

text.p: January trading volume at the MEFF financial futures exchange rose 26.22 percent to 3.09 million contracts from a year ago, the exchange said.
Volume for the equity-linked contract was 624,593 contracts, a rise of 64.85 percent year-on-year and a daily average of 29,743 contracts.
Fixed-income contract traded volume totalled 2.47 million contracts in January, up 19.17 percent year-on-year with 117,825 contracts traded on a daily average basis.
